description: Structured eval definitions for the Snowball Edge Deployer. Five-case proven set exercising the READY_TO_DEPLOY / PREREQUISITES_MISSING classification across Snowball Edge scenarios (import job with NFS, cluster mode for EKS Anywhere, NFS data transfer setup, export job, missing shipping address). Each eval maps to a prompt file and a baseline (no-skill) file for with-skill-vs-baseline comparison.

eval_cases.name: Snowball Edge import job to migrate on-premises data to S3
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — import job, Edge Storage Optimized, S3 destination bucket verified, data flow device → S3 after return noted
eval_cases.prompt: Create a Snowball Edge import job to migrate 150 TB of on-premises data to S3 bucket my-migration-bucket in us-east-1. Shipping address: addr-aaaabbbb. Device type: Edge Storage Optimized. Shipping option: NEXT_DAY. Tags: Environment=migration, Project=data-lift.
eval_cases.expected_output:
SNOWBALL_EDGE: <job-id> (IMPORT) — EDGE_STORAGE_OPTIMIZED
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Job type: Import (on-premises → S3)
  [✓] Device type: Edge Storage Optimized (210 TB usable)
  [✓] S3 bucket: my-migration-bucket (region: us-east-1) — destination
  [✓] Shipping address: addr-aaaabbbb — verified
  [✓] Data transfer plan: NFS parallel copy
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws snowball describe-job --job-id <job-id> --region us-east-1
  aws snowball list-jobs --region us-east-1

eval_cases.name: 5-node Snowball Edge cluster for EKS Anywhere edge compute
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — 5-node cluster, Edge Compute Optimized, EKS Anywhere, quorum tolerates 2 failures
eval_cases.prompt: Deploy a 5-node Snowball Edge cluster for edge compute in us-east-1. Device type: Edge Compute Optimized. I need EKS Anywhere for persistent Kubernetes at the edge. All 5 devices are on network 192.168.1.0/24. Shipping address: addr-cluster01. Tags: Environment=edge, Purpose=eks-anywhere.
eval_cases.expected_output:
SNOWBALL_EDGE: <job-id> (LOCAL_USE) — EDGE_COMPUTE_OPTIMIZED
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Device type: Edge Compute Optimized
  [✓] Cluster mode: 5 nodes (quorum: tolerates 2 failures)
  [✓] EKS Anywhere: supported (min 5 nodes)
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws snowball describe-job --job-id <job-id> --region us-east-1

eval_cases.name: NFS data transfer configuration on unlocked Snowball Edge
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — device unlocked, NFS interface started, parallel copy strategy, mount path provided
eval_cases.prompt: I have a Snowball Edge device unlocked at IP 192.168.1.100. I need to transfer 50 TB of data via NFS. Manifest file: manifest.bin. Unlock code: ABCD-1234-WXYZ-5678. Endpoint: https://192.168.1.100:9091. Provide the NFS setup and parallel copy strategy.
eval_cases.expected_output:
SNOWBALL_EDGE: device at 192.168.1.100 (NFS_TRANSFER)
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Device unlock: device UNLOCKED
  [✓] NFS interface: started (IP: 192.168.1.100)
  [✓] Data transfer plan: NFS parallel copy (16 threads)
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  snowballEdge describe-device --endpoint https://192.168.1.100:9091

eval_cases.name: Snowball Edge export job to download S3 data to on-premises
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — export job, data pre-loaded by AWS before shipping, source bucket noted
eval_cases.prompt: Create a Snowball Edge export job to download 60 TB of data from S3 bucket my-export-bucket in us-east-1 to on-premises. Shipping address: addr-export01. Device type: Edge Storage Optimized. Shipping option: NEXT_DAY. Tags: Environment=export, Project=data-distribution.
eval_cases.expected_output:
SNOWBALL_EDGE: <job-id> (EXPORT) — EDGE_STORAGE_OPTIMIZED
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Job type: Export (S3 → on-premises)
  [✓] S3 bucket: my-export-bucket (region: us-east-1) — source
  [✓] Shipping address: addr-export01 — verified
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws snowball describe-job --job-id <job-id> --region us-east-1

eval_cases.name: Snowball Edge import job without shipping address (prerequisite failure)
eval_cases.branch: PREREQUISITES_MISSING — no shipping address provided; AWS cannot ship the device
eval_cases.prompt: Create a Snowball Edge import job to migrate 100 TB of data to S3 bucket my-import-bucket in us-east-1. Device type: Edge Storage Optimized. I need to figure out the shipping address later. Tags: Environment=migration.
eval_cases.expected_output:
SNOWBALL_EDGE: import job
VERDICT: PREREQUISITES_MISSING
CHECKLIST:
  [✗] Shipping address: missing — AWS cannot ship the device without a valid physical shipping address
